title: ArtifactRef
description: A reference to a task artifact (tangible output). ArtifactRef points to the artifact but does not carry the artifact content itself. URI must be a valid absolute URI. hash is optional but recommended for verifiable artifacts. type is extensible.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task that produced this artifact.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run that produced this artifact.

type.description: Artifact type. Core types: 'pr', 'commit', 'document', 'log', 'report', 'schema', 'test_result', 'review'. Extensible — consumers must handle unknown types gracefully.

uri.description: Absolute URI pointing to the artifact. Must be a valid URI (e.g., https://github.com/..., file:///path/to/artifact, urn:ief:artifact:...). Plain relative file paths are NOT accepted.

hash.description: Optional content hash for artifact verification (e.g., SHA-256). Recommended but not required.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the artifact was created.

produced_by.description: Agent or runner that produced this artifact (agent_id or runner identifier).

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the artifact.
